jem_summary: Collect an actual item unearthed by your owned Leptictidium or Gnatusuchus.

pages.title: Digging for Two
pages.text: Collect an actual item unearthed by your owned Leptictidium or Gnatusuchus.

pages.title: Digging for Two
pages.text: Hide supports ancient travel equipment and rope ladders help leave excavation sites.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Leptictidium in Paleogene Messel Pit, tame with a Seed Pouch and sneak-use it; digging has a native two-minute cooldown. Neogene Pebas Gnatusuchus takes Raw Fillet, not Clam.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: In the Paleogene Messel Pit formation, use a seed pouch to tame a Leptictidium; shift-use a tamed one to trigger its digging behavior. Tamed creature unearths items with a documented two-minute cooldown.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Craft pelt-based grass or seed pouches and offer them to supported herbivores. Pouches support taming or breeding according to species.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find Gnatusuchus in the Neogene Pebas formation and offer Raw Fillet. The native guide describes a tame that can dig up items.
